correctness.rationale: The exact tridiagonal stiffness and consistent mass entries are correct. A=M+tau K is SPD and strictly diagonally dominant, so leading minors and right Schur pivots are positive. The 2x2 Schur elimination of Au=M e_j gives the explicitly positive nearest-neighbor numerator tau[1/2+a/(6b)+b/(3a)+(e/gamma)(a/(6b)-b/(6a))] with |e/gamma|<1. The tridiagonal inverse ratio forces negative P_{i,i+2} or P_{n,n-2} when any interior c_i=h_{i+1}/6-tau/h_{i+1}>0; Stieltjes inverse positivity and M>=0 prove sufficiency. The tau=0 and n=1,2 endpoints are explicit. A separate exact-rational solver checked 480 cases and 128 subthreshold witnesses. The unlimited quantifiers rest on the proof, not these cases.
